She smiled, climbed the winding stairs, and polished the great lens until it shone brighter than it ever had before.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在薄雾里投下昏黄的光圈，空荡的街道像一条沉睡的河。远处，环卫工人的扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。早点铺的蒸笼刚刚冒出第一缕白气，面香悄悄漫开。高楼的窗户大多黑着，只有零星几盏灯亮着，那是熬夜的人，或是早起的人。偶尔有出租车驶过，轮胎碾过湿润的路面，留下一声轻叹。天边还没有一丝亮色，但空气里已经有了黎明将至的味道，清冷，干净，带着一点点期待。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a Russian nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy keeps making the problem smaller until it is so tiny that the answer is obvious; that tiny case is called the stopping point.\n- Then the answers come back up one by one, like climbing back out of the dolls, and together they solve the big problem."}
